news.title: Save Archive #SaveSafe • @1MEMO_20261024 • Michel van der Burg • Miracles•Media • Save Our…
news.author: 1memo@pixelfed.social
news.snippet: Save Archive #SaveSafe • @1MEMO_20261024 • Michel van der Burg • Miracles•Media • Save Our Safe — The greatest challenge for the future is keeping our growing digital archives accessible. It is costly and time-consuming, but essential: storage formats change rapidly, and obsolete files cannot simply be opened. Meanwhile, large sums are being invested in AI to produce ever more digital knowledge, yet it draws only on the heritage that is already available in digital form. It is five to twelve: the analogue archives and digital knowledge are in danger of growing apart. What exists only on paper is no longer being made accessible. I see this in science, where much of the paper library is not available digitally and is, in effect, being lost: consulting purely analogue sources cannot compete with the rapid digital knowledge-gathering for the new generation of researchers. In this way, our history risks being abandoned through short-sightedness and replaced by an impoverished summary of whatever knowledge happens to be digitally available today. Text reworked and translated with the help of Claude. #SaveSafe #SaveArchive #archive #transition #digital #history #lost #education #erfgoed #science #AI #Claude #erfgoed

news.title: New preprint: "When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed" Agent h…
news.author: raimondas@hachyderm.io
news.snippet: New preprint: "When the harness decides success: state that cannot be re-observed" Agent harnesses drop old turns, summarize them, ask the model to keep notes, or replay its earlier reasoning, usually to save cost. When does that choice decide whether the agent succeeds? A pre-registered probe, plus a component-by-component decomposition of ARC-AGI-3's harness gap. Probe: truncating the context cost a low-cost reasoning model nothing when a needed fact could be looked up again. When the fact could not be re-observed, success fell to chance. The penalties differ by 92.5 points (90% CI 89.5–95.5), and a replication on a second provider's model agreed. Truncation also cost 2.9–4.0× as much in dollars as full history while sending fewer tokens, because dropping old turns breaks prompt caching. ARC-AGI-3, one model, four games: summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness's note-taking instruction, recovered 86% of a 63-point gap without reasoning replay. One run per configuration and game, so it's a lead, not a measurement. Not shown: real tasks, other models, or any ranking of models. Paper: https:// arxiv.org/abs/2610.26632 The pre-registration, amendments, code and cost ledger are open: https:// github.com/raimondasl/persistg ym # LLM # AIAgents # MachineLearning # ARCAGI
